Falsify the membership hypothesis only after every rank reports the same attempt/job identifier, world size, unique rank and local-rank mapping, rendezvous endpoint and resolved address, visible device UUID, communication interface, and collective sequence, and a checksum-verified tiny all-reduce completes on all ranks.

Before changing configuration, preserve a timestamped, redacted baseline: launcher and process-group arguments, per-rank host/container IDs, CUDA-visible devices and UUIDs, GPU topology and peer access, CUDA/communication-library/framework versions, store resolution and port reachability, chosen interfaces and routes, timeout, CPU/RAM/FD/SHM limits, placement, and the first blocked phase. Check for missing or duplicate ranks, wrong world size, stale stores or duplicate jobs, inconsistent environment, address-family/firewall/MTU problems, device permissions, and collective-order divergence. Treat measured values as facts and label estimates.

Run a minimal fixed-size all-reduce with a bounded watchdog, per-rank entry/exit timestamps, checksum, error, elapsed time, and explicit cleanup. Repeat matched trials with the same image, payload, seed, placement, and launch arguments in single-node, reduced-world, and full-world configurations; vary only the selected diagnostic factor and record both successes and timeouts. The focus for this record is the first controlled comparison, then expand only if its result warrants it. A result that reproduces only cross-host implicates membership/path/topology; a result that fails on one host implicates local visibility, permissions, or software. A successful trial does not prove production safety.

Rollback and safety: stop on watchdog expiry, rank disagreement, unexpected device access, or rising host/network load; terminate all child processes, remove only the diagnostic rendezvous state, restore the prior launch settings, and avoid destructive network or cluster changes. Redact tokens, addresses where policy requires, and customer data. Preserve logs, manifests, trial matrix, checksums, and timestamps for review; require operator authorization and domain-expert evidence before applying a remediation. Confidence is provisional because the actual topology, logs, and failure phase remain unobserved.
